Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concludes that George I of Greece died in Tatoi (near Athens), Greece, despite the Britannica page clearly stating that his place of death was Thessaloniki. The statement "Died March 18, 1913, Thessaloníki, Greece (aged 67)" is visible in the viewport of the Britannica webpage, but the Planner misinterprets or misreads it as "Tatoi (near Athens), Greece." This misinterpretation leads to the wrong solution to the real-world problem.
